description: The 2D plate inside the fluid: base normal re-aimed by tilt and yaw, offset, phase, spin, slab.

normal.description: Base plate normal (normalised by the adapter).
normal.title: Normal

offset.description: Plate offset h* along the effective normal.
offset.title: Offset

omega.description: Global spin rate of the plate, for inertial readings.
omega.title: Omega

phase.description: Plate phase theta (rad): in-plane axes rotate by theta.
phase.title: Phase

slab_half_width.description: Slab half-width w along the effective normal.
slab_half_width.title: Slab Half Width

tilt_deg.description: Aperture tilt beta away from the base normal.
tilt_deg.title: Tilt Deg

yaw_deg.description: Aperture yaw psi: precession about the base normal.
yaw_deg.title: Yaw Deg

title: PlatePose
